functions.name: abelalloc
functions.purpose: Allocate an Abel transformer and precompute its coefficients.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Coefficient loops use float intermediates and double-valued constants and pow; cancellation can affect coefficients.

functions.name: abelfree
functions.purpose: Free an Abel transformer and its coefficient arrays.

functions.name: abel
functions.signature: void abel (void *at, float f[], float g[]);
functions.purpose: Compute the Abel transform using a precomputed transformer.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Preserve the recurrence, traversal order and float accumulation order; input and output may alias.

functions.name: antialias
functions.signature: void antialias (float frac, int phase, int n, float p[], float q[]);
functions.purpose: Apply a Butterworth anti-alias filter before subsampling.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Recursive filtering and the forward-reverse zero-phase path depend on operation order and float rounding.

functions.name: hilbert
functions.signature: void hilbert (int n, float x[], float y[]);
functions.purpose: Approximate the Hilbert transform by convolution with a windowed filter.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Filter coefficients use cos and float storage; convolution accumulation order affects results. The filter is initialized in static mutable state.
